page.chartRequiredTitle: Lal Kitab needs a birth chart
page.chartRequiredDescription: Enter birth details to see your Lal Kitab Teva, its permanent houses, aspects and the rules behind each finding.

panel.title: Lal Kitab
panel.lede: Your birth chart read by Lal Kitab rules. Planets keep their houses, house 1 is always counted as Aries, and every finding shows the facts that produced it.
panel.chartNote: House numbers, not signs: house 1 is read as Aries whatever the rising sign.
panel.findingsLede: Strongest first. Open a finding to see why it applies.
panel.findingsEmpty: No foundation rule applies to this chart.
panel.aspectsEmpty: No planet aspects another planet in this chart.
panel.takkarEmpty: No planet strikes another by takkar.
panel.comingNext: Lal Kitab is complete for this release. Teva correction from life signs is in the Teva check tab.
panel.chandraNote: States are read from the Lagna Teva, so they are shown only there.

varshphal.title: Varshphal (yearly chart)
varshphal.lede: Each year of life remaps the birth houses by the 120-year table. The Sun marks the month chart; Mars marks the day chart.
varshphal.dhokhaNote: Planets that look settled in the birth Teva but face pressure in this year’s chart.
varshphal.summaryLede: Free shows the current year. Gold unlocks every year, month and day chart.
varshphal.teaser: Slide through all 120 years, open the month and day charts, and see which planets turn deceptive this year.

timeline.title: Life timeline
timeline.lede: Years 1–120: the 35-year cycle planet, maturity ages, and a soft tint for harder or easier Varshphal years.
timeline.aria: Lal Kitab life timeline from year 1 to 120
timeline.teaser: The full 1–120 timeline with cycle planets and maturity ages is part of the Gold reading.

learn.housesLede: What each house means in Lal Kitab, which planets signify it, and how it links to other houses.
learn.friendshipLede: The Lal Kitab table. It is not always mutual: read each row as how that planet sees the others.
learn.rulesLede: Lal Kitab aspects run one way, forward from the lower house, and their strength comes from the pair of houses.
learn.takkarRule: Takkar: a planet strikes whatever sits eight houses ahead of it (1 strikes 8, 2 strikes 9, and so on). It hurts when the two are enemies.
learn.bunyadRule: Bunyad: the ninth house from any house is its foundation. A weak foundation weakens the house built on it.
learn.timeLede: Year of life is completed age plus one. The 120-row table remaps birth houses each year. The first column repeats every twelve years.
learn.masphalRule: Masphal turns the year chart so the Sun sits in the month house; Dinphal turns the month chart so Mars sits in the day house. Both follow common commentary practice.
learn.remedyNote: Lal Kitab remedies are traditional practices. They are not medical, legal or financial advice.

soyaGhar.name: Soya ghar (sleeping house)
soyaGhar.rule: an empty house that no planet looks at. It stays quiet until its waking planet is strengthened.

soyaGrah.name: Soya grah (sleeping planet)
soyaGrah.rule: every house it looks at is empty, so it has no one to act on. Planets in houses with no forward aspect are not counted.

kayam.name: Kayam grah (established)
kayam.rule: no enemy sits with it, looks at it or strikes it, so it gives its own result in full.

dharmi.name: Dharmi grah (pious)
dharmi.rule: Rahu in 4, Ketu in 11, Saturn in 11, and any planet sitting with Jupiter and Saturn together. It does no harm.

andhi.name: Andhi Teva (blind chart)
andhi.rule: house 10 holds planets that are enemies of each other.

ratandh.name: Ratandh Teva (night-blind)
ratandh.rule: the Sun in house 4 and Saturn in house 7.

nabalig.name: Nabalig Teva (minor chart)
nabalig.rule: houses 1, 4, 7 and 10 all empty; results settle after about age 12.

dharmiTeva.name: Dharmi Teva (pious chart)
dharmiTeva.rule: Jupiter and Saturn in the same house.

kismat.name: Kismat ka grah (planet of destiny)
kismat.rule: an exalted planet first, then a planet in its permanent house, then the first planet in houses 9, 10 or 11.

learn.commentaryNote: The waking table, the blind and night-blind conditions and the destiny method follow common commentary; they will be checked against the 1952 text.
learn.masnuiLede: Two planets in one house that together behave like a third.

overview.chartTypeTitle: What kind of chart this is

headline.mixed: A chart of give and take
headline.hard: A chart that asks for care

overview.headlineLede: Of the nine planets, {good} give their good side, {mixed} give both sides and {hard} lean to their hard side.
overview.balanceAria: Planet balance: {good} good, {mixed} both sides, {hard} hard
overview.strengthsEmpty: No supporting rule stands out in this chart.
overview.challengesEmpty: No hard rule here beyond the debts and doshas below.
overview.nowText: {left} of its {span} years are left in the 35-year cycle. {next} comes next.
overview.debtsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None found} one {# found} other {# found}}
overview.debtsEmpty: No hard dosha or debt in this chart.
overview.debtsNote: Debts are common in Lal Kitab charts. Each has a family remedy.
overview.startNone: No planet needs a remedy right now.
overview.allLede: Every rule that applies to this chart, strongest first. Open one to see why.

planets.title: Planets
planets.lede: Each planet's house, state, what it stands for, who it looks at, and the rules that apply to it.
planets.noFindings: No rule applies to this planet alone.

houses.title: Houses
houses.lede: Each house: who sits there, who looks at it, whether it is asleep and which planet wakes it.

drishti.title: Drishti and takkar
drishti.lede: Lal Kitab aspects run forward only. Rows look at columns; colour shows friend or enemy.
drishti.matrixCaption: Aspect strength, row planet looking at column planet

combos.masnuiLede: Pairs in one house that behave like a third planet.
combos.masnuiEmpty: No masnui planet forms in this chart.
combos.pairsLede: What each pair sharing a house does. Pairs that form a masnui planet are read above.
combos.pairsEmpty: No two planets share a house.

predictions.areasLede: Each area is read from the planets in its houses and from its karaka planets.
predictions.quietText: No planet sits in this area's houses, and its karakas are not placed, so it follows the rest of the chart.
predictions.phalLede: Each planet's reading in its house. The side shown is the one the chart's state points to.

reason.dharmi: It is dharmi, so it does no harm
reason.pakka: It is in its permanent house
reason.enemyTakkar: An enemy strikes it by takkar

predictions.asleep: It is asleep, so it gives this result only once woken
predictions.maturity: Its results ripen from about age {age}
predictions.source: These readings restate each planet's karakas in each house in our own words. They will be checked against the 1952 edition.

nishaniyan.resultLede: Tick the signs below that you see in your life. Each planet's signs are compared with what the chart says.
nishaniyan.signsOnlyHint: Signs without a hard reading can mean the birth time is off, or that the planet is hard in the current year's chart (Varshphal comes in a later update).
nishaniyan.listLede: Lal Kitab reads these everyday signs as a planet turning hard. Tick only what has happened to you or your home.
nishaniyan.privacy: Your ticks are kept only in this browser.

doshas.title: Doshas the Lal Kitab way
doshas.lede: Lal Kitab judges a dosha by the state of the planet behind it, so the same placement can be a dosha in one chart and harmless in another.
doshas.none: No Lal Kitab dosha is formed in this chart.
doshas.remedyNext: Remedies for each dosha are in the Remedies tab.

rin.title: Rin (karmic debts)
rin.lede: A rin is a debt carried from the family's past, shown by set planets in set houses. Lal Kitab clears it together: the whole family joins one remedy on one day.
rin.none: No karmic debt is shown in this chart.
rin.teaser: What it comes from, its signs and the family remedy are part of the full reading.
rin.how: every blood relative gives an equal share, the shares are put together on one day, and the remedy is done once, in daylight.
rin.clearTitle: Debts not shown in this chart

upay.topLede: One remedy for each planet that needs help, most needed first. Do one per planet at a time.
upay.noneNeeded: No planet in this chart needs a remedy right now.
upay.notNeeded: Left alone because they already give good results: {list}.

blocked.strengthensHarmer: Not now: strengthening {planet} would add to the harm it does to {victim}.
blocked.releasesKismat: Not now: {planet} is your planet of destiny, and this gives its things away.

rules.days: Keep it up for the stated days in a row (usually 43).
rules.restart: If you miss a day, start the count again.
rules.onePerPlanet: Do one remedy per planet at a time.
rules.onlyHard: Only treat a planet that is hard or mixed; leave a good planet alone.
rules.self: Do it yourself. Family remedies for debts are done by the whole family together.
rules.eclipse: Do not start on an eclipse day.
rules.noHarm: Never use a remedy to harm anyone.

upay.safety: Lal Kitab remedies are traditional practices. They are not medical, legal or financial advice; for health, money or legal trouble, see a qualified professional as well.
upay.byPlanetLede: Every remedy that suits each planet in its house, what to avoid, and any remedy the conflict check holds back.
upay.wakeLede: A sleeping house stays quiet until its waking planet is strengthened.
upay.wakeSkip: Skipped: the waking planet is hard in this chart.
upay.rinNote: Family remedies for karmic debts are in the Rin tab.

finder.title: Remedy finder
finder.lede: Pick a problem. The finder looks at the planets behind it in your chart and gives their remedies.
finder.behind: Planets behind this in your chart: {list}
finder.supported: Your chart supports this area; no remedy is needed. Keep the general rules and prohibitions.
finder.teaser: The planets behind this problem in your chart, and their remedies, are part of the full reading.
finder.safety: For health, money or legal trouble, see a qualified professional as well.

tracker.title: 43-day remedy tracker
tracker.lede: Start one recommended remedy and tick it off each day. Only today's box can be ticked; if you miss a day, restart from day 1.
tracker.noneActive: No remedy is running for this chart.
tracker.startLede: Pick one of the top remedies for this chart. Only one active remedy per planet.
tracker.noStarters: No remedy is needed for this chart.
tracker.rules: Start in daylight. Do not start on a Saturday night or during an eclipse. Keep going for the full stretch; a miss means start again.
tracker.teaser: Saved 43-day progress for your remedies is part of Gold.
tracker.todayOpen: Today is day {n}. Tick it once you have done the remedy.
tracker.todayDone: Today is done. Come back tomorrow.
tracker.missed: A day was missed, so this run is broken. Restart to begin again from day 1.
tracker.completed: All days done. This remedy is complete.
tracker.replaceConfirm: A {planet} remedy is already running ({done} of {total} days done). Lal Kitab allows one remedy per planet at a time, so starting this one ends it. Start anyway?
tracker.unknownRemedy: This remedy is no longer in the catalogue.

correction.title: Teva check from life signs
correction.lede: Tick the signs you see in life. The engine shifts the Lagna by up to two hours and ranks which rising sign best matches those signs — without changing planet positions.
correction.teaser: Scoring a ±2 hour Lagna window from your Nishaniyan ticks is part of Gold.
correction.signsLede: Same list as Nishaniyan. Ticks are saved in this browser and shared with that tab.
correction.needMore: Tick at least two signs so the check has enough to work with.
correction.resultLede: Each row is a rising sign reachable within about ±2 hours of the recorded birth time.
correction.suggest: Best match: {best} ({hours}). Recorded Lagna is {current}. Re-check the birth time toward that window, then rebuild the chart.
correction.currentBest: The recorded Lagna already matches the signs best in this window.
correction.hintsLede: For planets the signs flag as hard, houses that often weaken them on their own (debilitation first).
correction.disclaimer: This is a decoding aid, not a guarantee. Hospital records and family timing still come first. Remedies and predictions stay traditional guidance, not medical or legal advice.
